author: Matt Walsh
description:
For decades, historians and pundits have treated the Watergate affair as the quintessence of American political scandals. The events changed the course of history, led to the resignation of an American president, and ushered in a new era of politics. We were taught the coverup was worse than the crime. But decades later, thousands of pages of declassified documents and sworn testimony tell a totally different story: one of intrigue, sabotage, betrayal, and deep state subversion. This is the Real History of Watergate.
